title: A-02 harden audit and test gates against vacuous green
businessRules: Post-audit finding A-02 (CRITICAL, P0, targetPhase P0) is canonical in config/product-completeness.json and this work item does NOT close it. It closes two demonstrated instances - the ci:r8:probe constant checks and the marker-only evidence length check - plus a regression gate that pins both. A-02 stays IMPLEMENTED_RUNTIME_PENDING until a full sweep proves no remaining audit or test can report green without substance; editing the status string is forbidden.
A gate may not report PASS from a constant. Every PASS a gate emits must be derived from an artifact that gate actually read during this run; a boolean literal used as a result is a defect.
Missing evidence is a failure, never an omission. An expected artifact that is absent, unparsable, or lacking the identity the gate claims to verify must fail the gate closed.

A status of RUNTIME_VERIFIED or HUMAN_ACCEPTED requires at least one resolvable exact-source evidence reference. Free text in the evidence array is not evidence; prefer binding the real runtime artifact over downgrading the status, and downgrade only when no exact-source artifact exists.

This work item is verification-layer only. No business logic, API contract, permission, tenant/branch authority, schema, or runtime mutation path may change, and no existing assertion may be weakened to keep a gate green.
productReady remains false, currentPhase remains P5, humanStage20 remains PENDING; hardening a gate cannot promote any product status.

Scope was chosen by evidence, not by convenience: a scan of every scripts/*.mjs checks literal found zero remaining all-literal checks objects, and the probes that emit status PASS (ci-r1, ci-r2, ci-r4, ci-r6, ci-p2, ci-p3) are fail-fast or downstream-enforced, so those were not rewritten.
acceptanceCriteria: scripts/ci-r8-release-evidence-probe.mjs fails closed when a referenced evidence artifact carries no sourceIdentity, instead of silently skipping the staleness comparison; any artifact exempted from fingerprint binding is listed explicitly with documented rationale.

The probe's executedCriticalScenarios check is derived, not vacuous: each of the twelve critical scenario ids must map to at least one artifact that is PASS and bound to the current fingerprint, and the check fails when a mapping row loses its artifact rather than passing because a table length equals twelve.
exactSource, r8ReportingSecurity and humanStage20Pending in the probe output are computed from the evidence read, not emitted as constants.

Every feature in config/product-completeness.json with status RUNTIME_VERIFIED or HUMAN_ACCEPTED has an evidence entry that resolves to a real file in the repository or a named GitHub run artifact; feature pos_offline is bound to its actual offline-sync runtime artifact or downgraded to IMPLEMENTED_RUNTIME_PENDING with documented rationale.
A dependency-free regression test fails the build when any such feature carries unresolvable evidence, so the invariant survives future edits.
Both GitHub heavy workflows stay green with the hardened probes, and no gate, test, or assertion is removed, narrowed, or bypassed to achieve that.
testPlan: node --test tests/vacuous-green-gate.test.mjs — negative controls: an artifact without sourceIdentity, an artifact whose fingerprint differs, a scenario mapping row whose artifact is missing or not PASS, and a RUNTIME_VERIFIED feature with unresolvable evidence must each make the gate fail; the twelve existing scenario ids must still resolve
node --test tests/recovery-r8-runtime-uat.test.mjs — the R8 evidence chain still passes on real artifacts
node --test tests/work-item-path-resolution.test.mjs — work-item resolver guard stays green
npm run audit:product:completeness and npm run audit:full:repo — canonical matrix still passes with no marker-only closure introduced
npm run lint, npm run workflow:validate, npm run validate:repo

GitHub exact-source Full Automated UAT and Full System Simulation: hardened ci:r8:probe and ci:r8:reporting-security-probe execute and the aggregate summary/assert stay PASS with productionTouched=false
migrationPlan: No schema migration. Only verification scripts, one dependency-free regression test, and canonical status evidence references change; no database object is added, altered or dropped.
rollbackPlan: Revert the A-02 commit. The probes return to their previous (weaker) behaviour, no data is written, no status is promoted, and no production runtime path is affected. Because the change is verification-layer only there is no compensating operation to unwind and no feature flag is required; the prior commit remains a valid green checkpoint.
monitoringPlan: Observe both GitHub heavy workflows plus Workflow Governance on the exact commit: ci:r8:probe, ci:r8:reporting-security-probe, the full-system summary gates and ci:summary:github:assert must remain PASS, and ci:uat:coverage must continue to report evidenceClass SOURCE_CONTRACT with runtimeClosure false. If the hardened probe fails, the aggregate fails visibly and the run must be read as a real defect rather than re-tuned.
securityNotes: A false-green verification layer can silently mask a security regression, which is why A-02 is rated CRITICAL. This change must only add fail-closed checks; it must not introduce an allow-list, skip, or exemption that lets an artifact be accepted without identity binding, must not weaken the restricted-operator denial or digest recipient verification asserted by the reporting/security probe, and must not print, persist or diff credential material while inspecting artifacts. Evidence files stay in handoff/quality and CI artifacts; no secret, token, or database URL is read into a test assertion or log line.
